name: CASABLANCA Booking Engine
author: CASABLANCA

sections.description:
Author: Martin Hairer (martin.hairer@casablanca.at)

This plugin synchronises room types, rates, and availability from the CASABLANCA IBE v2 API and renders SEO-friendly booking widgets. Guests complete booking and payment on the CASABLANCA booking engine (PCI-safe redirect).

Requirements

The plugin is free to install, but it only works with the hosted CASABLANCA Booking Engine (external IBE API and booking website). You need a valid Tenant ID and API key from that service under CASABLANCA Booking in the admin. Without an active Booking Engine account, sync and widgets cannot load live data or hand guests off to complete a booking.

Features

  • Background ARI sync with audit log
  • Daily WP-Cron task (staggered on first save)
  • Gutenberg blocks and matching shortcodes (search, calendar, rooms, packages, detail pages, price teaser)
  • Overview → detail links via pretty URLs /{detail-page}/{slug}/
  • Live calendar via same-origin REST proxy
  • Backend configuration with encrypted API key
  • Theme and per-site CSS overrides
  • Environment mode via CASABLANCA_BOOKING_ENV in wp-config.php

License note: The plugin source is free software under AGPL-3.0-only; you may use, modify, and share it under that license. That is separate from the CASABLANCA Booking Engine service and API key needed for live operation.

External services

This plugin requires the third-party CASABLANCA Booking Engine v2 operated by CASABLANCA hotelsoftware GmbH. It is not a generic booking plugin: without that service, widgets show no live availability and guests cannot complete reservations.

What it is used for: Background sync of room types, rates, and availability; live calendar and offer data; redirecting guests to the CASABLANCA booking website for checkout and payment. WordPress never stores payment card data.

What data is sent and when:

  • Admin configuration, connection test, and sync (when you save settings, click Sync, or WP-Cron runs): Tenant ID and API key are sent to the CASABLANCA IBE API (default https://api.casablanca.at, or staging hosts when CASABLANCA_BOOKING_ENV is set in wp-config.php).
  • Calendar and offers on the public site (when a visitor loads or interacts with a widget): stay dates, occupancy, optional room or rate filters, and culture/language. No WordPress login or site visitor identity is sent to CASABLANCA for these requests.
  • Search and book (when a visitor submits the search bar or a book button): the visitor’s browser is redirected to your hotel’s CASABLANCA booking URL with arrival, departure, occupancy, and optional room or rate identifiers.

Service provider: CASABLANCA hotelsoftware GmbH — Terms of use, Privacy policy.

Shortcodes

  • [casablanca_search_bar]
  • [casablanca_calendar]
  • [casablanca_room_types]
  • [casablanca_packages]
  • [casablanca_room_detail]
  • [casablanca_package_detail]
  • [casablanca_price_teaser]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or copy the casablanca-booking-engine folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings → Permalinks and click Save once (registers detail-page rewrite rules).
  4. Open CASABLANCA Booking in the admin menu.
  5. Enter Tenant ID and API key, then save.
  6. Insert blocks or shortcodes on your pages.
sections.faq:
Do I need CASABLANCA Booking Engine to use this plugin?

The plugin itself is free under AGPL-3.0-only. To work on a live site you need an active CASABLANCA Booking Engine subscription (Tenant ID + API key). The plugin has no standalone booking function; it connects to CASABLANCA’s external API and booking engine.

How do I run sync manually?

Use Sync now in the admin module, or wp casablanca-booking sync when WP-CLI is available.

How do I use staging API hosts?

Add to wp-config.php:

define('CASABLANCA_BOOKING_ENV', 'staging');

How do I link room/package cards to a detail page?

  1. Create a detail page and add the Room details or Package details block.
  2. On the overview block, set Card link to Details and select that page.
  3. Cards link to /{detail-page}/{slug}/. No fallback id is required on the live URL.
  4. If detail pages show “not found”, save Settings → Permalinks once.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Calendar offers: reuse one booking offer and recalculate it when dates or occupancy change (fewer CreateBookingOffer calls).

1.0.2

  • API authentication: send the raw key in the api-key request header (no Bearer token).

1.0.1

  • WordPress.org review fixes: plugin directory slug, distribution zip contents, inline theme CSS sanitization, text domain alignment.

1.0.0

  • Initial WordPress plugin.
  • Room/package detail URLs resolve the synced slug from the last path segment.
